planRows.shortDesc: Our stylish retreat rests along the Riviera Nayarit. Take turn towards "Camino A Higuera Blanca" and in 2 km, take turn towards "LITIBU" complex at the roundabout.

From North: Follow Puerto Vallarta - Tepic / México 200 and turn right onto Av. Revolucion and continue to Punta de Mita until Litibu.

Cancun International Airport, CUN, is about 90 minutes from the resort (62.1 m).
Please contact the resort concierge to help arrange private transportation. Our partners in destination marketing services will help you coordinate the arrivals and departures of your group.

planRows.shortDesc: Our resort on Ambergris Caye offers exclusive access to Belize’s only private Beach Club. A 15-minute free boat ride will take you to our white sand beach with cabana beds, overwater hammocks, and beach service from the bar and grill. Discover our restaurants, pool, village, and marina. Diving and adventure tours can be arranged by our tour operator.
planRows.headline: Private beachside service near San Pedro
planRows.locationShortDesc: Mahogany Bay Resort & Beach Club is located 1 1/2 mile south of San Pedro in Ambergris Caye.  Beaches, diving, and rejuvenating are our key features.
planRows.hotelTeaserText: The newest resort in Belize and only resort with a private beach club and features 10 food and beverage outlets for the best resort experience
planRows.directionsTo:
Upon arrival at Goldson International Airport (BZE) in Belize City, proceed to Tropic Air for a scenic 15-minute flight to San Pedro (SPR) on Ambergris Caye, which is 51 nautical miles from BZE. Contact reservations@mahoganybayresort.com to have us book your domestic flight to the island and/or your cab transfers from SPR to the resort.

Alternatively, there are several water taxi services available from the port in downtown Belize City to San Pedro, a trip that takes approximately 1.5 hours. To get from BZE to the water taxi port, you must take a cab for 10 miles (typically 30–50 minutes) that will cost approximately $10USD.

Enjoy unique tours surrounded by endangered species and scenic landscapes.
planRows.headline: Unique oasis in the heart of Santa Cruz Island
planRows.locationShortDesc: Located in the highlands of Santa Cruz Island, a 45-minute drive from Baltra(GPS) airport, and 25 minutes from the city center.
planRows.hotelTeaserText: The Royal Palm is a secluded hide-a-way nestling in the lush Miconia highland forests of Santa Cruz in the heart of the Galapagos. Located only 20 minutes-drive from the bustling port town of Puerto Ayora, our guests can enjoy privacy, space and quiet seclusion in our 8 Standard Rooms and 13 Villas.
planRows.directionsTo:
Your trip starts from Quito or Guayaquil airport to GPS airport at Baltra island in Galapagos.
Once at Baltra a public bus will take you to Itabaca's Channel (10-15 min drive). At the channel a public ferry will transport you to Santa Cruz Island (5-10 min). When you arrive to Santa Cruz you can take a taxi to come to the hotel (30-35 min)
You can always request transfer service to info@royalpalmgalapagos.com at an additional cost.

There is one main road from south to North in Santa Cruz Island.  The hotel is located in the middle of island at the middle of the main road in KM 18 via Baltra.  
Since there is only one main road the guests can take any car up to KM 18 where the hotel is located.  From the main street a 5-10 min drive will take them to the hotel buildings.

The five-star Hilton Colón Quito Hotel is strategically situated 10 minutes from the historic quarter of Quito, the first site to be classified World Heritage Site in 1978 by UNESCO, and some steps away from the city’s financial and commercial center. Its position makes it the most accessible hotel from highways and the recently-upgraded Ruta Viva road, as well as the Guayasamín Tunnel linking Quito with the country beyond. 

The New Mariscal Sucre International Airport is located in the quiet and basic town of Tababela, 40km/25Mi from central Quito. Reaching the airport from the city takes 50-90 minutes, depending on your location and time of departure: a short journey to see the natural and historic wonders of the Quito.

planRows.directionsTo:
TRANSPORTATION TO OUR RESORT FROM LOS CABOS INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT
Hilton Los Cabos is 20 minutes by taxi from San Jose Del Cabo International Airport. The hotel is located on the Carretera Transpeninsular Km. 19.5, between San Jose del Cabo and Cabo San Lucas. The hotel is a 10 minute drive from San Jose del Cabo and a 17 minute drive from Cabo San Lucas. 
The resort offers private transportation to and from the airport with different vehicles to choose from. Check our transportation page to learn more and book your airport pickup. 
Taxis and shuttles are available by inquiring at the 'Taxi' desk after clearing customs. Car rental agencies are available in the baggage claim area.

planRows.shortDesc: Unparalleled relaxation and renewal await where the Pacific Ocean meets the Sea of Cortez, on the southern tip of Mexico’s Baja California Peninsula. Enter paradise through the private Dos Mares tunnel for a luxurious stay at Waldorf Astoria Los Cabos Pedregal, a Forbes Five-Star resort and spa carved into the mountain. Set on 24 acres, our resort is near the pristine Los Cabos beach at the heart of the activity.
planRows.headline: Cliffside paradise in Los Cabos
planRows.locationShortDesc: Seaside and cliffside, outside and in, The Waldorf Astoria Pedregal is the ultimate in luxury resorts, via Mexico’s only privately owned tunnel
planRows.hotelTeaserText: Waldorf Astoria Los Cabos Pedregal is situated on the southern tip of the Baja California peninsula between San Jose Del Cabo and Cabo San Lucas, 45 minutes southwest of San Jose Del Cabo International Airport.
planRows.directionsTo: From SJD Intl. Airport, take the toll road to Cabo San Lucas and proceed to Downtown Cabo San Lucas. Turn left  onto Calle Cabo San Lucas. At the roundabout continue straight onto Blvd Paseo de la Marina. Turn right onto Camino del Mar (Pedregal Entrance) and turn left when you see the "Waldorf Astoria Los Cabos Pedregal" sign (35 Km)

planRows.shortDesc: One block from the Cinta Costera and close to the financial district, our hotel offers luxury in the heart of the city. Surrounded by the nightlife of Calle Uruguay, restaurants and minutes from Casco Viejo, enjoy exclusive services such as our award-winning spa, modern fitness center, locally inspired cuisine and the only personal concierge in Panama certified by Les Clefs d'Or.
planRows.headline: Panama City views and Calle Uruguay nightlife
planRows.locationShortDesc: The Waldorf Astoria Panama is located blocks away from the City's Business District and steps away from a diversity of Restaurants & Pubs.
planRows.hotelTeaserText: Your home away from home located in the heart of Panama City, offering calm rooms and True Waldorf Service. Featuring an outdoor pool, modern fitness center, Spa service, and delicious F&B options, you are sure to find all the details to create the best hotel stay of your life.
planRows.directionsTo: Exit the airport on Avenida Domingo Diaz heading towards Panama City. Approximately 2 miles, take the Corredor Sur (Pan American Highway) exit heading towards Panama City. Follow Corredor Sur for approximately 15 miles and take the Avenida Balboa exit (note, you will pass through 2 toll booths before seeing signs for Avenida Balboa). Follow Avenida Balboa approximately 2.5 miles and exit right onto Aquilino de la Guardia. Take Aquilino de la Guardia 1 block and turn left onto 47th St.

planRows.shortDesc: Nestled among lush mangroves, Waldorf Astoria Riviera Maya is a sanctuary of luxury, culture, and wellness. With 173 oceanfront rooms and suites, the resort offers transformative experiences inspired by the sacred Yaxché tree. Discover daily curated activities — from sunrise yoga to cultural rituals — and enjoy exclusive access to nearby championship golf courses. Refined accommodations, exceptional dining, and a deep connection to Riviera Maya’s spirit await.
planRows.headline: Welcome to the Riviera Maya’s Secret Treasure
planRows.locationShortDesc: The Waldorf Astoria Cancun is a beachfront property with 173 guest rooms and suites. The resort has 3 restaurants, 2 bars/lounges and a luxury Spa.
planRows.hotelTeaserText: Experience a treasured beauty that brings meaning and enchantment to every moment.
planRows.directionsTo: From Airport- take Carretera Cancun-Chetumal 307 South.
